COMPRESS-177.label: R
COMPRESS-177.reason: Direct overlap. This report is about `TarArchiveInputStream` behavior on a TAR-related failure path, and the current test also exercises `TarArchiveInputStream.getNextEntry()` on a corrupt TAR expecting an `IOException` whose cause is `IllegalArgumentException`. Same subsystem (`archivers.tar`) and same mechanism: exception translation/wrapping during TAR header parsing.

COMPRESS-171.label: P
COMPRESS-171.reason: Same archive factory / TAR detection area, but the mechanism is different. This report concerns misclassification of short text files as TAR archives in `ArchiveStreamFactory.createArchiveInputStream`, i.e. detection heuristics, not exception wrapping during parsing. Useful only as regional context for the archive stream factory/TAR entry point.

COMPRESS-169.label: P
COMPRESS-169.reason: Shares the broader “corrupted archive causes wrong exception type” theme, but it is in the ZIP subsystem (`org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipFile`) rather than TAR. Mechanistically it involves runtime failure on corrupted input, which may hint at error-handling patterns, but it is not close enough to localize the TAR parsing bug strongly.
